<div class="page-intro">CLARS is an international research program examining climate-related migration, urban change, and the movement of climate knowledge across the Lake Victoria Basin and the North American Great Lakes.</div>

## Research focus

The Van Berkel Lab leads work on **urban migration modeling** and contributes to **climate knowledge exchange**. The research asks how climate-related mobility may reshape cities, land-use patterns, infrastructure demands, and environmental conditions, while also examining how decision-relevant climate knowledge is produced and used.

## Study regions

Work spans cities in the **Lake Victoria Basin** and the **North American Great Lakes**, creating a comparative framework for studying migration, urban change, and adaptation across very different institutional and environmental settings.

## Methods

Spatial modeling · land-change simulation · participatory GIS · scenario analysis · geovisualization · climate knowledge co-production
